incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: latency.slo.p99.euw > 750ms (3m). Incident PD-48291. Auto-page: #eng-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.com/PD-48291
Priya: acked via PD — I'm on it, checking Grafana and traces.
Carlos: pulling metrics now. p99 jump at 13:02 UTC, looks concentrated in eu-west dedicated cluster.
oncall-sre: any error logs? quick grep in sidecar logs:```
2026-03-17T13:02:05Z WARN kvcache: miss_rate=0.78
2026-03-17T13:02:07Z WARN router: fallback to cold model -> increased latency
```
Priya: good catch — kvcache miss rate spiking. also seeing a bunch of FailedCreate events from autoscaler around the same time: `FailedCreate: quota exceeded` in kube events.
Jordan: sounds like scale-up couldn't keep up -> tail latency. Customer impact? any 5xxs?
Carlos: 5xxs stable, mostly 200s but long tail; some interactive customers might notice slow responses. Impact: low-high latency, no errors.
Priya: plan: 1) temporarily route traffic away from canary to warm pool, 2) bump dedicated pool 2->4 nodes, 3) trigger kvcache warmup. I'll run step 1 now.
Carlos: doing route change: `POST /admin/route?from=canary&to=warm&dry=false` -> 200 OK.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-48291 acknowledged by Priya (ack id: 9876).
Priya: scaling dedicated pool: `infractl scale --pool=dedicated-eu --nodes=4` — queued. kicking off cache warmup with `curl -X POST https://platform/api/warmup?scope=kvcache.euw`.
oncall-sre: watching tail latencies on the live dashboard. ETA for scale to finish ~90s.
Carlos: noticed a noisy client with large seq len causing extra kv evictions. throttling that client at edge for now (rate-limit).
Priya: scale finished, warmup returned 202, routing shows traffic to warm pool.
incident-bot: p99 now reported 420ms (was ~820ms). trend: decreasing over last 2m.
Jordan: looks stabilized. keep PD open for at least one retention window. Priya, can you add short RCA note and follow-up action to prevent autoscaler quota stall?
Priya: will file follow-up (investigate quota bump, autoscaler backoff tuning, cache eviction thresholds). Handoff: I'll continue monitoring for 30m then hand off to night oncall if still open.
Carlos: will add a temporary alert: kvcache.miss_rate > 0.5 -> pager but with suppression for expected warmups.
Priya: closing loop for now — customer impact = degraded latency; mitigations applied (route, scale, warmup, rate-limit). Will update PD with timeline and postmortem epic. :thumbsup:
